Research model · evidence first
How we choose the tips
  • Up to three markets, with at most one from each market group. At least 60 prior league games and eight games per team are required.
  • Model estimates must be between 60% and 85%. We avoid extreme goal lines and reject negative model value when a current supported bookmaker quote is present.
  • Highest model probability ranks first. This is a transparent shortlist rule, not proof of accuracy. Markets can still be correlated.
  • The percentage bar shows estimated probability, not a measured confidence score. Uncalibrated estimates are labelled.
  • Tips are saved before kickoff. Won/lost uses final regulation scores or recorded statistics. Unsupported settlements stay pending.
  • Dotted odds are model fair prices, calculated as 1 / probability. Bet365 prices, when shown, are saved snapshots rather than live offers.
